_comment: Where character-02's garments can be (metres, character space centred on z=0: x across, y front-negative, z up). Palette: a dark navy wool coat, a cream shirt open to the sternum, brown leather belts/straps/pouch, black trousers, tall black boots. The coat and shirt are slightly saturated (navy chroma ~12, cream ~12), so cloth takes everything under chroma 20; the brown leather (chroma > 20) stays leather. The black boots read as cloth by colour, so leather_boxes_m makes everything below the coat hem (z -0.43, the hem is at -0.38) leather. Bare skin: the hands, the neck and the open shirt's chest.
_detail: character-02 is painted (Arcane-like): the painting's buttons, buckles, stitching and shoulder emblem are the style. At the defaults (detail 0.3, light gamma 0.5, fine 0.65), made for Ennix's photo-like paint, they blurred away, and the cream shirt, sharing the cloth class with the navy coat, was pulled to grey. Light is left as painted (gamma 1.0): even 0.9 pulled the cream shirt toward the dark navy cloth median. 2026-10-10.
_skin: His tan skin is colourful (Lab chroma ~50, hue ~56 deg); the cream shirt is not (chroma ~16, hue ~76) but passed the default skin test (chroma > 14, hue 40-80) inside the open-collar neck region, so the game shaded the shirt as skin. 2026-10-10.
